terra.problem: “Any other night” adds a time of day the passage does not give and suggests how Lazarus behaved at the dinner.
“Shoulders would be a whole different dinner” doesn't make a clear joke or comparison.
Luke 22:61 does not establish that Peter was one of the twelve. That detail needs a reference that does.
The passage says Judas did not ask because he cared about the poor. It does not say categorically that he didn't care about them.
The explanation says keeping the money bag was why the perfume got Judas's attention. The passage does not give that reason.
The explanation places the crowd at the dinner, has them lining up, and says Lazarus was trying to eat. The passage does not give those details.
The explanation assumes Martha was serving when the crowd came and guesses that she did not notice them. The passage does not establish that timing.
